sections.heading: Registration form
sections.lead: Six short steps, for groups and MSMEs alike. Nothing here is a commitment — a field officer will confirm everything with you.

sections.body: **You do not need documents to fill this in.** Answer what you know and leave the rest. We contact you within five working days to go through the rest together.

steps.label: About the group
steps.heading: About the group
steps.intro: First, what kind of group is this?

options.title: Chama or self-help group
options.body: Members save together, usually weekly or monthly

options.title: Table banking group
options.body: Members save and lend to each other from the same fund

options.title: Community-based or faith-based organisation
options.body: Serving a community rather than only its own members

options.title: Cooperative or producer group
options.body: Members produce, process or sell together

options.title: A small business
options.body: One enterprise rather than a members’ group

options.title: Something else
options.body: Tell us in your own words on the next step

steps.label: The group’s name
steps.heading: The group’s name
steps.intro: The official name if you have one, and what people actually call it.

fields.name: gname
fields.label: Group name
fields.hint: If it is not registered yet, use the name you intend to register.

fields.name: gdesc
fields.label: What the group does
fields.placeholder: e.g. We are 22 women in Kamukunji. We save 500 shillings a week and lend to members for school fees and stock.
fields.hint: In your own words, in English or Kiswahili. This helps us prepare before we call.

steps.label: Where you are
steps.heading: Where you are
steps.intro: So we can send the right field officer.

fields.name: county
fields.label: County
fields.hint: We have field officers across Nairobi’s sub-counties and several other counties. If yours is not covered, you can still register — the process runs by phone.

fields.name: meet
fields.label: Where and when the group meets
fields.hint: Field officers come to you, including evenings and weekends.

steps.label: Who we should speak to
steps.heading: Who we should speak to
steps.intro: One person we can reach. Usually the chairperson or treasurer.

fields.name: cphone
fields.label: Phone number
fields.hint: We call or send an SMS. We never ask for money or a PIN, by phone or otherwise.

steps.label: Where the group stands
steps.heading: Where the group stands
steps.intro: There is no wrong answer. Most groups start with none of this.

options.title: We started but got stuck
options.hint: Tell us where — we probably know that office

fields.name: members
fields.label: Roughly how many members?
fields.hint: An estimate is fine. Ten or more is usually needed to register a group.

fields.name: acct
fields.label: Does the group have a bank account in its own name?

options.title: No
options.hint: The treasurer usually holds the money personally

steps.label: What you want help with
steps.heading: What you want help with
steps.intro: Choose as many as apply. This shapes who we send.

checkboxes.title: Opening a group bank account
checkboxes.body: So the treasurer stops holding it personally

checkboxes.title: Loans or financing
checkboxes.body: Group lending, LPO or asset finance

checkboxes.title: Bookkeeping and records
checkboxes.body: Training a treasurer can actually use

checkboxes.title: KRA PIN and eTIMS
checkboxes.body: So the group can invoice and supply

checkboxes.title: A dispute in the group
checkboxes.body: Mediation, before it splits the group

checkboxes.title: Adult education or literacy
checkboxes.body: For members who want to read their own books

consents: I confirm the group has agreed to this enquiry, and I may share these details.
CECF may contact me by phone or SMS about this enquiry.
steps.consentHint: Your details are used only to help your group. They are not sold, and they are not shared with a bank or any other institution unless you ask us to. You can ask us to delete them at any time.

confirmation.heading: Thank you — we have your enquiry
confirmation.body: A field officer covering **{county}** will call **{phone}** within **five working days**.
nextSteps: We call to arrange a visit, or to talk it through by phone if that is easier.
We go through what your group already has, and what is missing.
We prepare the papers together. Your group approves everything before it is filed.
confirmation.footnote: Nothing has been submitted to any government office. This is an enquiry to CECF only. If you need to reach us sooner, call **0709 000 000**.
confirmation.demoNotice: Demonstration form — connect to the CECF enrolment platform before publication. Nothing entered here has been stored.
